Subject: Foundry cohort — credits request for MosaicAI

Hi Aisha,

I'm reaching out from Foundry Accelerator on behalf of one of our portfolio companies, MosaicAI (founded by Evan Liu). We're preparing our next demo day cohort and would like to request a pilot credit allocation from Redwood so MosaicAI can scale a small proof-of-concept during the 6-week acceleration track.

They expect to run ~250M tokens during the program (inference + evals) and would benefit from a 3-month promotional pool. Can you share eligibility requirements and what kind of credit sizes/pacing Redwood typically provides to accelerators?

Basic context: MosaicAI is pre-Series A, revenue <$250k, demo-ready prototype focused on vertical search and summarization. If you need a pitch deck or incorporation docs I can loop them in.

Thanks — Lina
Program Manager | Foundry Accelerator

Hi Lina — thanks for the note and the context. Happy to review MosaicAI for a program allocation. To triage quickly can you ask Evan to share the following (we can accept these as attachments or links):

- Short pitch deck (3–10 slides) with product and usage profile
- Expected token volume (monthly) and the biggest generation paths (chat vs batch embeddings vs long-document summarization)
- Confirmation of incorporation and primary HQ (needed for program eligibility)
- Any data residency / compliance constraints (PII, regulated data)

High-level guidelines we use for accelerator partners: typical promo pools range from $3k–$25k in hosted credits depending on cohort size and technical fit; for startups doing heavy evaluation work we sometimes frontload a larger one-time promo and then transition to a discounted committed plan. If MosaicAI is strictly demo/proof-of-concept with the numbers you quoted, I would expect us to propose an initial $10k pilot pool with the option to extend (requires a short review and approval).

I'll loop David (solutions) for a technical pass and Grace (partnerships) for approval on exceptions. If you can get the deck over today we'll move quickly.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the deck, Evan — quick technical notes from the solutions side:

- Long seq-length summarization (2.5k avg) favors a model variant with optimized attention kernels; depending on MosaicAI's tolerance for quality loss we can suggest a quantized 8-bit configuration which reduces cost by ~35% and keeps latency within demo SLOs.
- For batch embeddings: we recommend using our embedding cache to avoid duplicate computation; small changes to batching (micro-batches of 50–100) will improve throughput without raising tail latency.
- Allocation suggestion: start MosaicAI on a $10k hosted credit pool scoped to the demo cohort (90 days) with an engineer check-in at day 30 to evaluate usage trends and propose either a top-up or a move to a discounted committed starter bundle.

If this aligns with program expectations I can document the technical scope and the quantization recommendation in an internal note for billing to reference. Also cc'ing Monica (CS) to track onboarding cadence.

- David
David Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
